subject: English
question_text: Change the sentences according to directions.
stimulus: (a) Nelson Mandela was an extraordinary leader in the world history. (Make exclamatory sentence) (b) He guided South Africa from the shackles of apartheid. (Make interrogative sentence) (c) All his life he struggled against apartheid. (Make compound sentence) (d) It was the government policy of racial segregation. (Make negative sentence) (e) The black were not treated kindly. (Make affirmative sentence) (f) The black were subjected to all sorts of indignities. (Make complex sentence) (g) Though the black were the citizens of South Africa, they were treated like dogs. (Make compound sentence) (h) The great leader vowed so that he could put an end to the inhuman practice. (Make simple sentence) (i) The rulers threw him behind the prison bars to dominate the black. (Make complex sentence) (j) Could the oppressive rulers break his spirit? (Make assertive sentence)
guide_solution: Changing sentences: (a) What an extraordinary leader Nelson Mandela was in the world history! (b) Didn't he guide South Africa from the shackles of apartheid? (c) It was apartheid and all his life he struggled against it. (d) It was not the government policy of racial unification. (e) The black were treated unkindly/cruelly. (f) It was the black who were subjected to all sorts of indignities. (h) The great leader vowed to put an end to the inhuman practice. (g) The black were the citizens of South Africa but they were treated like dogs. (i) The rulers threw him behind the prison bars so that they could dominate the black. (j) The oppressive rulers could not break his spirit.
